title: Vegan Midnight Flatbread
description: A delicious and easy-to-make flatbread perfect for a quick midnight snack, vegan-friendly and perfect for satisfying your cravings.
instructions: Cut the flatbread into bite-sized pieces.
Mix the greek and craving ingredients together in a bowl.
Add the bread to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the top is lightly golden.
Sprinkle with rye and serve warm.
